frame: glTF axes: +x right (the model is the right side; mirror x for the left), +y up in body axes (metres above the main-gear contact plane), +z aft of each part's anchor station

anchors.Filler: the middle of the gap it fills; scale z to its length (its own length is 1 m)
anchors.Seat: the seat's front station, x on its centre
anchors.Armrest: the seat's front station, x between two seats
anchors.Psu: each row's front station on the seat's side (its panel runs from psu.from to psu.to aft)

attribute.name: _CABIN
attribute.r: ambient occlusion within 0.6 m (on Seat, Armrest and Psu a hit at d open by (d / 0.6)^0.7)
attribute.g: window-wash light, 1 at the brightest sidewall corner
attribute.b: window form factor: share of the cosine-weighted hemisphere seeing out through a window
attribute.a: 1; 0.5 on the PSU's forward half (the always-lit no-smoking sign)
